myAccount.title: My Account
myAccount.subtitle: Settings that belong to you rather than to the organization.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Appearance and workflow settings, stored with your account rather than this browser.

security.title: Sign-in security
security.description: Whether a second factor is required is an organization setting. What you use to satisfy it is your choice.

descriptions.owner: Everything, including backups and integration tokens.
descriptions.editor: Creates content, publishes it, and manages screens and playback.
descriptions.contributor: Creates and edits content, but cannot publish a Layout, delete anything, or put content on a screen.

users.accessDenied: Owner or Administrator access is required to manage Studio users.

addForm.title: Add a user
addForm.passwordHint: Passwords must contain at least 12 characters.

mfa.required: Two-step verification required, not yet enrolled

editDialog.title: Edit {{name}}
editDialog.mfaEnrolled: This account has an authenticator app or a passkey enrolled.
editDialog.mfaNotEnrolled: This account has no second factor enrolled.
editDialog.resetConfirmTitle: Clear every authenticator, passkey, and recovery code for {{name}}?
editDialog.resetConfirmBody: They will be signed out everywhere and must enroll again.
editDialog.deleteBody: This removes their login, preferences, and security credentials. This cannot be undone.

errors.requestFailed: Tilecast could not update this account.

security.loadError: Sign-in security could not be loaded.

authenticator.title: Authenticator app
authenticator.description: A six-digit code from an app such as Aegis, Google Authenticator, or 1Password.
authenticator.enrollInstruction: Scan the code with your authenticator app, then enter the six-digit code it shows.
authenticator.manualKeyLabel: Cannot scan? Enter this key by hand:
authenticator.removeDescription: Confirm your password to remove the authenticator from this account.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in with a fingerprint, face, screen lock, or security key. A passkey signs you in on its own and counts as two-step verification.
passkeys.unavailableTitle: Passkeys are unavailable on this installation.
passkeys.browserUnsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
passkeys.renameHint: Tilecast named this from the authenticator that created it.
passkeys.removeDescription: Confirm your password to remove this passkey from this account.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.description: Single-use codes that let you sign in when you cannot reach your authenticator or passkey.
recovery.dialogDescription: Confirm your password to generate new codes. Any existing recovery codes stop working.
recovery.shownOnceDescription: Save them somewhere safe now. Tilecast stores only their hashes and cannot show them again.

errors.requestFailed: Tilecast could not complete the request.

qr.failed: The QR code could not be displayed. Enter the key below by hand instead.

preferences.leaveWarning: Leave My Account with unsaved preference changes?
preferences.conflict: These preferences changed elsewhere. Reload the latest preferences before saving.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Follow this browser, or force Studio light or dark.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language Studio uses for you. Names, content, and messages from Players are not translated.
